Asha: Quick follow-up on multi-region residency: propose a lightweight "ownership token" flow instead of full active/active. Owner pointer + short-lived consent tokens + strict policy modes. Sketch below.

Ben: Short summary of modes?

Asha: Three modes per-tenant: owner-only, sync-with-consent, eventual. Owner-only blocks non-owner writes. Sync-with-consent allows forward with valid token. Eventual accepts provisional local writes and reconciles later.

Clara: How do proxies get tokens?

Asha: Control-plane issues consent tokens into escrow KV; proxies cache them with epoch. Token = `consent:v1:<tenant>:<epoch>:<owner>`. Token TTL 30s-2m. On policy/owner change control-plane bumps epoch to invalidate tokens.

Dmitri: DB invariants: owner mints canonical ids and enforces uniques. Provisional local writes get provisional ids and are rectified during reconciliation. Reconciliation must be idempotent and able to emit compensating ops.

Ben: What about cross-region p99 when we forward?

Asha: Fast path uses cached token -> proxy does a single forward with short timeout (200-300ms). If owner times out and policy allows eventual, proxy enqueues provisional and returns 202. Otherwise return timeout/fallback per tenant.

Clara: Telemetry and audit? Need `residency.decision`, `residency.latency_ms`, `residency.reconcile_lag_ms` and audit events for every cross-region forward. PII tenants require KMS-encrypted escrow and extra audit sinks.

Dmitri: Revocation: control-plane increments token epoch and publishes a revocation fanout to edge proxies so tokens are dropped quickly. Also proxies validate epoch on manifest refresh.

Asha: Proposed owners: escrow/token lifecycle -> Clara (eng-runtime), proxy changes -> Ben (eng-platform), reconciliation worker -> Dmitri (eng-sre), policy + revocation fanout -> product/infra.

ops-bot: quick sim: 20k reqs/tenant, 50% writes, inter-region p95=240ms. With 60% token hit-rate, observed app p95 for sync-with-consent drops ~45%. Logs -> https://ci.redwood/sims/ownership-token/3765432100

Asha: I'll draft RFC addendum with sequence diagrams, header proto (`X-RW-Residency: owner=us-west;consent=...;mode=sync`) and a canary plan (non-PII tenants, single region pair). Volunteers for reviewers?

Ben: I'll review the proxy section.

Clara: Will add token lifecycle details.

Dmitri: I'll review reconciliation semantics.

Asha: Great — thanks. Will post draft later today. :rocket:
